datasets.title: Transcriptomic analysis reveals distinct adaptive molecular mechanism in the hippocampal CA3 from rats susceptible or not-susceptible to hyperthermia-induced seizures
datasets.summary: Here we conducted a temporal analysis of the transcriptomic and microRNA changes in the ventral CA3 of rats that develop (HS group) or not-develop (HNS group) seizures after hyperthermic insult on the eleventh postnatal day. The selected time intervals corresponded to acute, latent, and chronic phases of the disease.
datasets.study_design: 热性惊厥易感与非易感大鼠海马CA3区，miRNA与mRNA表达谱时间序列分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 利用热诱导惊厥大鼠模型海马CA3区转录组与miRNA数据
datasets._9cc601: SOGEN·索臻·标注这道工序我们替你做了·增量更新加群·公众号光热生物/科研风向标/组学料理

evidence.relevant: 高热诱导惊厥幼鼠模型直接对应热性惊厥，样本来自该模型海马CA3，研究其易感性与分子机制
evidence.sequencing_type: 样本描述明确含Gene expression（63例）和miRNA expression（58例），数据处理用Agilent Feature Extraction，为两种微阵列技术组合。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本为大鼠，非人类患者，无法进行患者生存分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较为惊厥发作易感性表型，无药物或治疗干预对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 热惊厥诱导大鼠模型，对照组仅标注“Control”，缺少“naive/untreated”正向健康标签，treatment_protocol亦提及“following hyperthermic insult”，符合P3诱导模型sham对照陷阱，无法确认对照为独立真健康动物。
evidence.correlation: 样本为大鼠模型，非人类疾病样本，动物模型不计入相关性分析所需患者数
evidence.sample_source: 121个GSM的source均为“rat hippocampal ventral CA3”，treatment_protocol显示新鲜脑组织离体后立即放入RNAlater提RNA，无细胞分选或体外培养，属整块组织直接测序。

datasets.overall_design: Use of a rat (Rattus norvegicus) model of hyperthermia-induced seizure to characterize the genomic mechanism underlying febrile seizures in epilepsy. The aim of the study is to identify the genomic differences in hippocampal ventral CA3 region - through differential gene expression, miRNAs, and WGCNA transcriptional modules among animals with (HS) or without (HNS) seizure after insult and non-insulted controls (CT). Here, samples from the animal of all groups in the P30 time-interval.

evidence.correlation: 动物模型样本不计入患者样本，无可用的独立人类患者样本观察数，无法做相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 全15例GSM source均为大鼠海马腹侧CA3区新鲜离体组织块，未分选/培养即直接匀浆提取RNA，属整块实体组织直接测序，按Q2+Q3归tissue。

datasets.title: Transcriptomic analysis reveals distinct adaptive molecular mechanism in the hippocampal CA3 from rats susceptible or not-susceptible to hyperthermia-induced seizures
datasets.summary: This study aimed to identify the genomic differences - through differential gene expression, miRNAs, and WGCNA transcriptional modules among animals with or without seizure after insult and non-insulted controls.
datasets.overall_design: Use of a rat (Rattus norvegicus) model of hyperthermia-induced seizure to characterize the genomic mechanism underlying febrile seizures in epilepsy. The aim of the study is to identify the genomic differences in hippocampal ventral CA3 region - through differential gene expression, miRNAs, and WGCNA transcriptional modules among animals with (HS) or without (HNS) seizure after insult and non-insulted controls (CT). Here, samples from the animal of all groups in the P60 time-interval.
datasets.study_design: 大鼠热惊厥模型海马腹侧CA3区，miRNA芯片检测，比较惊厥、无惊厥与未刺激对照组。
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用大鼠热惊厥模型海马组织，探究热性惊厥相关的miRNA差异。

evidence.relevant: 大鼠高热诱导惊厥模型直接研究热性惊厥的基因组机制，样本为模型动物海马组织，主体轴与样本轴均满足。
evidence.sequencing_type: GEO数据类型为Non-coding RNA profiling by array，摘要明确研究miRNAs，数据处理使用芯片杂交特征提取软件(Feature Extraction)，故推断为miRNA microarray。
evidence.survival_analysis: 全部样本为大鼠，非人类患者，不存在临床生存时间与状态字段，无法做患者生存分析。
evidence.treatment: 干预为热刺激诱导惊厥建模，无药物处理组与对照比较，药物非核心变量。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: GSM group包含HS(5)、HNS(5)、CT(5)，摘要明确CT为non-insulted controls，即未接受热诱导的正常大鼠，平台为Non-coding RNA profiling by array（miRNA表达），每组n=5满足≥3。
evidence.correlation: 惊厥组仅5只大鼠，总疾病相关样本数远低于16，无法进行可靠表达相关性分析。
evidence.sample_source: 所有15个GSM均取大鼠海马腹侧CA3组织，离体后立即放入RNAlater保存并提取总RNA，未进行细胞分选或任何体外培养/刺激，为整块组织直接检测。
